messages:
maria (sec-oncall): Alert from our anomaly detector — a single service account 'svc-backup-202' performed ~220 KMS Decrypt calls against key alias/rdw-prod-backups in a 3m window (03:12 UTC). S3 GETs to s3://prod-backups/archives/ spiked too.
ajay (eng-oncall): confirming. grabbing cloudtrail & kms logs now. Is this an automated backup job?
maria (sec-oncall): backups normally run from 'svc-backup-001' and are rate-limited. This acct is odd. I see multiple IPs in a narrow range.
sabrina (infra): tagging as INCIDENT-202503—I'll be IC unless someone else takes it. Setting priority P0.
nate (sre): I'll start containment: revoke active sessions for svc-backup-202 and remove kms:Decrypt from its role policy. Will also add a deny in IAM session policy if needed.
ajay (eng-oncall): copying commands — doing quick revoke:
```bash
aws sts revoke-session --access-key-id AKIA... --region us-west-2
# removing inline policy
aws iam delete-role-policy --role-name svc-backup-202 --policy-name BackupDecrypt
```
maria (sec-oncall): Good. Also set S3 bucket policy to block GetObject for that principal and enable object-level logging (if not set).
sabrina (infra): Done: added explicit bucket deny for principal arn:aws:iam::123456:role/svc-backup-202 and enabled data events in CloudTrail for s3://prod-backups/ archives prefix.
ajay (eng-oncall): Collected logs: attaching a snippet from CloudTrail (sanitized).
```
{ "eventTime":"2025-03-01T03:12:14Z","eventSource":"kms.amazonaws.com","eventName":"Decrypt","userIdentity":{"arn":"arn:aws:iam::123456:role/svc-backup-202"},"sourceIPAddress":"54.123.45.67" }
```
maria (sec-oncall): suspicious pattern: decrypts across multiple regions with same role — suggests compromised creds or lateral use of role. Checking last IAM policy changes.
tom (product-security): Starting vuln triage: any recent deploys that touched backup tooling?
ajay (eng-oncall): Not in last 72h. Last change to backup config was a minor schedule tweak two weeks ago.
cleo (legal): If there's potential user data exposure, we need data classification and notify privacy. Hold comms until we have scope.
maria (sec-oncall): Initial scope: look for objects accessed after 03:10 UTC in prefix archives/. Also search for listBucket/listObjects calls.
nate (sre): Forensics: spinning a readonly snapshot of the control-plane hosts that run backup jobs and preserving container logs. Taking EBS snapshots ID:snap-0abc.
ajay (eng-oncall): I've created a short-term KMS key policy that denies Decrypt for the role and scheduled a key-disable in 2h (to allow rollback if needed). Policy diff:
```
- Allow: kms:Decrypt -> role/svc-backup-202
+ Deny: kms:Decrypt -> role/svc-backup-202
```
sabrina (infra): Good. Also rotating any static credentials used by backup tooling is required. Who owns the vault entries?
maria (sec-oncall): Vault entries owned by infra oncall (sabrina) and backup team (ajay). Sabrina, please rotate service credentials and mark as force-rotate for the next deployment.
sabrina (infra): On it. Rotating creds in HashiCorp Vault, marking old tokens as compromised.
ajay (eng-oncall): I've blocked the suspicious source IPs via WAF and VPC NACLs as a temporary measure.
maria (sec-oncall): Evidence collection checklist:
- preserve CloudTrail + KMS logs (done)
- snapshot S3 objects accessed (starting)
- collect backup job container logs (in progress)
- record IAM change history (in progress)
- contact registry teams if images pulled from external registries
- ticket for legal & privacy (cleo)

cleo (legal): I have a tracking ticket. Waiting on confirmed scope before external notice.
maria (sec-oncall): Communication plan: internal all-hands if data confirmed exfiltrated, otherwise targeted notices. No external comms yet.
tom (product-security): Post-incident action items (tracked in ISS-1721):
- rotate & audit all backup-related principals
- harden IAM role assumptions (shorter session durations, stricter condition keys)
- enforce KMS key policies with deny-lists for unusual principals
- augment anomaly detectors for KMS usage patterns
- run a full vulnerability scan on backup containers

nate (sre): ETA on creds rotation and snapshots: creds rotated in 12m, snapshots completed 14m.
ajay (eng-oncall): Confirmed: revoked sessions succeeded, bucket deny applied, blocked IPs. No obvious exfil tool signatures in logs so far.
maria (sec-oncall): Timeline note: 03:10 UTC detection -> 03:14 UTC revoke -> 03:18 UTC bucket deny -> 03:26 UTC WAF block -> 03:42 UTC snapshots complete.
sabrina (infra): I'll prepare concise handoff doc for next oncall with artifacts: list of snapshots, CloudTrail export link, KMS usage CSV, IAM diffs.
maria (sec-oncall): Handoff plan: I'm handing incident to ajay for overnight monitoring and root cause follow-up. ajay will be IC for 03:50–11:50 UTC.
ajay (eng-oncall): I accept. I'll monitor alerts, run expanded searches for other principals, and start root-cause timeline. Notes added to ISS-1721.
cleo (legal): Please DM me if user data is confirmed; we'll coordinate any regulator notifications.
maria (sec-oncall): Final: ensure audit logging retention extended for 90 days for this incident window. Also schedule a postmortem call tomorrow 14:00 UTC.
ajay (eng-oncall): Acknowledged. Leaving war-room — handing to ajay.
pagerduty-bot: Incident ISS-1721 assigned to ajay (eng-oncall).
